target_definition: Scalar U column from UrbanTALES-flowdata.csv for each idealized case; sample vertical profiles are separately integrated and compared as a diagnostic, not substituted for the full-table targets

excluded_features.height_mean_m: constant at 16 m across these idealized cases
excluded_features.building_count: retained for traceability; omitted from engineered predictor set
excluded_features.layout_id: identifier used for grouping, not a predictor
excluded_features.family_id: grouping variable used for validation, not a predictor
excluded_features.configuration_metadata_label: kept for traceability; folder-code configuration is used because CL/SM labels are inconsistent in the catalogue

validation: 224 cases, 112 layouts, 16 families; no missing values; one record per simulation_id. The three ZIP archives are read and audited, but contain sample coverage only.
